key_insight: BiMuon preserves matrix structure in stochastic bilevel optimization by combining implicit hypergradient estimation with Muon-style orthogonalized upper-level updates.
engineering_relevance: The approach targets matrix-valued learning problems where lower-level curvature can create spectral imbalance in upper-level optimization.
method: Estimate upper-level hypergradients implicitly through the lower-level problem.
Apply Muon-style orthogonalized matrix updates with an O(ε⁻⁴) iteration-complexity guarantee.
Use a block-diagonal approximation and allocate relative step sizes by upper-level progress and blockwise lower-level sensitivity.
evidence_signal: Evaluations on representation learning and blockwise bilevel optimization provide empirical support, but the abstract reports no quantitative gains.
watch_item: Practical benefits should be weighed against hypergradient estimation and orthogonalization costs; block-diagonal approximations may miss cross-block interactions.
paper_title: BiMuon: A Geometry-Aware Stochastic Bilevel Optimization Approach
